headline: Mooring County Casualties Surge as Nevish Line Battles Rage
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, severe attrition has intensified in Mooring County, where combined casualties surged past 4,700 over the past two hours despite no further strategic bases changing hands. Nevish Line remains the war's most volatile sector, racking up five additional base events and more than 3,600 losses across Grief Mother, Unruly, and The Scrying Belt as fighting continues unabated. Linn of Mercy recorded five further base transitions centered around Outwich Ranch and Rotdust, though infantry engagements there have slowed in recent hours. Heavy combat also persists along Callahan's Passage, yielding over 2,100 casualties in the two-hour window following earlier turmoil at Crumbling Post. To the east, Stlican Shelf experienced a sharp uptick in bloodshed, logging nearly 2,900 casualties in two hours, while Weathered Expanse and Marban Hollow maintain steady fighting without fresh structural flips. Meanwhile, the southern backlines remain entirely quiet.
